what: An 8-track groovebox: kick, snare, metal, perc and 4 synths, 17 own engines and SAMPLE on every track. 32-step sequencer, 16 patterns, sound and mix locks, conditions, ratchets, 16 live FX, arpeggiator, 8-channel USB audio. Every track draws its own visual. Menus in English, Spanish or Portuguese.
author: fantasmogenesis
sounds: own: textures synthesized in code or recorded by fantasmogenesis; the Felucca base adds CC0 samples from Versilian Studios VSCO (vendor/Felucca/assets/samples-cc0)
